Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.Game
public class Game extends Object
Represents a Galaxy Trucker game session. Manages game state, players, components, and game flow according to Galaxy Trucker rules. Handles initialization, ship building, flight phase, card effects, and scoring
